name: create_task_plan
description: Create a detailed action plan for a complex task. Use this when a task requires multiple steps, involves approvals, or needs structured breakdown before execution. Supports email replies, payments, social media posts, file processing, and general tasks.

task_data.description: Task metadata dictionary (from, subject, priority, is_urgent, amount, recipient, platform, etc.)

task_content.description: Full content of the task file (markdown with frontmatter)
